summary: Deck empty-state softlock: stale resume cursor hides re-pooled skipped rows, no reset affordance
description: After an apply, skipped rows return to the pending pool BEHIND the reviewer's saved resume cursor (IndexedDB, per filter). The deck fetches id > cursor -> empty page, and the empty state ('No more in this filter') renders without the Start-from-top affordance (the resume banner only shows when a card is displayed) — softlock: header count says N pending, deck shows none. The count query ignores the cursor, so remainingInFilter is correct at that moment; use it to render a reset button in the empty state that clears the saved cursor and refetches from the top. Same trap in EdgeDeck (skipped edges); CleanupDeck inherited it. Reported live: 13 pending, empty cleanups deck.
